focus.defect: A MODEL_ADMISSION_EVIDENCED proof could be attached to a different provider/model/revision/taskClass candidate because tournament admission checked proof state but not exact proof identity. Execution-time revalidation had the same intended binding, but the positive fixture itself used an identity-less proof and could not demonstrate the stricter path.
closure: frontier task tournament admission now requires proof.identity to match exact provider + model id + revision + taskClass before scoring
execution-time routing revalidation preserves the same exact identity binding
focused fixtures carry the exact identity they claim
hostile cases reject borrowed model proof, provider substitution, revision substitution and taskClass substitution

verification.byteIdentity: All four reconstructed files matched their Git blob identities before execution.

rebase.method: The 19 Night Frontier files were additive relative to current main. Their exact existing Git blobs were overlaid onto the current-main tree, preserving all newer main files and avoiding stale-history merge semantics.

limitations: Focused proof does not substitute for npm run check:syntax && npm run test:deterministic on the exact final head.
